facts.fact: The article states that Americans have one of the highest rates of cell phone ownership in the world, with 96% owning one (figure attributed to Pew Internet, a third-party source).
facts.quote: Americans have one of the [highest rates](https://www.pewinternet.org/fact-sheet/mobile/) of cell phone ownership in the world, 96% actually owning one

facts.fact: The article says it is believed that 81% of US cell phones are smartphones (unsourced estimate).
facts.quote: It is believed that currently 81% of these are smartphones.

facts.fact: The article cites NHTSA data stating that distracted driving resulted in 3,166 deaths in 2017.
facts.quote: 3,166 people and all statistics show that texting is by far the most dangerous activity.

facts.fact: The article claims, citing insurance and law firms in the US, that texting is 6 times more likely to cause an accident than driving drunk.
facts.quote: It is 6 times more likely to cause an accident than driving drunk, according to insurance and law firms in the US.

facts.quote: SMS open rates are a whopping 98%, opened within less than 90 seconds.

facts.fact: Groomsoft's text appointment reminders can be sent once or twice prior to each appointment based on the business's settings.
facts.quote: Text message appointment reminders can be sent once or twice prior to each appointment based upon your settings.

facts.fact: Groomsoft's example configuration sets the first reminder at 1 week and the second at 2 days before the appointment; the article notes this is only an example.
facts.quote: you may want to set the first Text Message Appointment Reminder at 1 week and the 2nd at 2 days prior.

facts.fact: In Groomsoft, customers confirm a reminder by replying Yes, or by replying Oui if the business is in Canada.
